name: Copper Helix Vastu Spiral, Set of 3
shortDescription: Three triangular copper spirals, a traditional Vastu decor piece for home or office.
description:
A set of three flat triangular spirals in copper, each with a warm polished finish.

In Vastu practice, copper spiral shapes are traditionally placed in the south-east of a room or building. They are also simply an elegant, minimal decor piece for a shelf, desk or wall.

What you receive: 3 copper spiral pieces.

name: Lapis Lazuli Bead Bracelet
shortDescription: Deep blue lapis lazuli beads with natural golden flecks, strung as a single bracelet.
description:
A single-strand bracelet of round, polished lapis lazuli beads. Each bead has its own pattern of deep blue with golden flecks, so no two bracelets look exactly alike.

Lapis lazuli has been prized for its colour for thousands of years and is traditionally associated with wisdom and calm reflection.

Care: keep away from perfume, water and harsh chemicals; wipe with a soft dry cloth.

name: 7 Chakra Lava Stone Bracelet
material: Lava stone, seven coloured stone beads, gold-tone metal spacers and charms
shortDescription: Black lava stone beads with seven coloured chakra beads and gold-tone accents.
description:
A bracelet of textured black lava stone beads, with a row of seven coloured beads representing the seven chakras, from violet to red. Gold-tone spacers, two studded cube beads, a pyramid bead and a hamsa hand charm complete the design.

The seven chakra colours come from the yogic tradition, where each colour is linked to one of the body's seven energy centres.

Care: keep away from water and perfume; wipe with a soft dry cloth.

name: Clear Crystal (Sphatik) Bracelet
shortDescription: Clear, glass-like sphatik beads in a clean, minimal bracelet.
description:
A single-strand bracelet of round, clear quartz beads, known in India as sphatik. The beads are polished to a water-clear finish that catches the light.

Sphatik has a long place in Indian devotional practice and is traditionally associated with calm and clarity of mind.

Care: keep away from harsh chemicals and hard knocks; wipe with a soft dry cloth.
